🎥🎬: Insecure (2016–2021)

Issa Dee is a young Black woman navigating the complicated realities of adulthood, relationships and career ambitions in Los Angeles. Alongside her best friend Molly Carter, a successful but romantically frustrated lawyer, Issa tries to figure out what she wants from life while dealing with insecurities, disappointments and the pressure to have everything figured out.

As Issa struggles with her long-term relationship with Lawrence, she begins questioning whether she is settling for a life that no longer makes her happy. Meanwhile, Molly faces her own challenges balancing professional success with her complicated dating life. Their friendship becomes a constant source of support, laughter and occasional conflict as they navigate love, betrayal and personal growth.

Through awkward encounters, messy relationships, workplace drama and brutally honest conversations, the two women discover that growing up means making difficult choices, accepting mistakes and learning to embrace who they really are.
